Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Sorrell
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 372 as introduced exempts virtual currency from ad valorem taxation. Virtual currency is not subject to ad valorem tax, and due to this, this bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
